render.prompt: Character design reference for a cozy retro top-down adventure game: a small shore crab apprentice with a dusky purple shell, one oversized gold claw and one small claw, eyes on short stalks, wearing a too-big cream apron, holding a rubber stamp. Full body, front view, standing upright facing the viewer, centered, chunky cute proportions with a big head. 16-bit pixel art style, clean flat colours, bold dark outline, simple readable shapes. Plain solid flat magenta background, no shadow, no text, no frame.
